下列各組「」內的文字，何者前後相同？
       (A)膏「ㄩˊ」之地／阿「ㄩˊ」諂媚     (B)「ㄧㄢˇ」旗息鼓／屋舍「ㄧㄢˇ」然
       (C)「ㄐㄧㄠˇ」倖獲勝／「ㄐㄧㄠˇ」俗干名 (D)圖文並「ㄇㄠˋ」／「ㄇㄠˋ」林修竹

下列成語用字，何者正確？
       (A)蓬壁生輝   (B)錐心泣血        (C)趨之若鶩      (D)莫衷一事

下列文句「」中的成語，何者使用正確？
       (A)他對課業總是「牛角掛書」、敷衍了事，難怪成績差
       (B)下課鐘聲一響，小朋友猶如「新鶯出谷」般衝出教室
       (C)陳老闆經商失敗，以致失去鬥志，從此「一蹶不振」
       (D)張教授做實驗總是「管窺蠡測」，謹慎細心絕不馬虎

下列各組成語，何者意義最為相近？
       (A)螳臂當車／蚍蜉撼樹             (B)白雲蒼狗／白駒過隙
       (C)斬草除根／竭澤而漁             (D)鳳毛麟角／九牛一毛

下列詩詞所描繪的季節，何者有誤？
       (A)千里鶯啼綠映紅，水村山郭酒旗風—春天 (B)木槿花開畏日長，時搖輕扇倚繩床—夏天
       (C)菡萏香銷翠葉殘，西風愁起綠波間—秋天 (D)梅英疏淡，冰澌溶泄，東風暗換年華—冬天

下列有關方位語詞的解釋，何者有誤？
       (A)「馬耳東風」形容充耳不聞          (B)「剪燭西窗」形容喪妻之痛
       (C)「北窗高臥」形容悠閒自適          (D)「虛左以待」形容禮賢下士

陳義芝《草堂沉思》：「千年前為秋風所破的茅屋／剩日下的竹影搖曳／我小立在那座新築新
       修的草堂／遙想當年你如何扶杖嘆息，忍聽／兒童抱茅的嬉鬧」，詩中所述人物為下列何者？
       (A)蘇軾     (B)屈原       (C)王維          (D)杜甫
                    共同科目(國文、英文) 第 1 頁，共 4 頁       【請翻頁繼續作答】

王安石《登飛來峰》：「不畏浮雲遮望眼，自緣身在最高層。」其中的浮雲係比喻小人、佞
       臣，下列文句中的「浮雲」，何者具有相同意涵？
       (A)不義而富且貴，於我如浮雲    (B)浮雲遊子意，落日故人情
       (C)總為浮雲能蔽日，長安不見使人愁 (D)浮雲一別後，流水十年間

下列各組詞語所指涉的物品，何者相同？
       (A)玉盤／金烏  (B)魚雁／尺牘                               (C)金甌／絲竹                (D)汗青／杜康

辛棄疾《青玉案》：「東風夜放花千樹，更吹落，星如雨。寶馬雕車香滿路，鳳簫聲動，玉
        壺光轉，一夜魚龍舞。」係描述下列何種節令的場景？
        (A)元宵節    (B)清明節   (C)中秋節   (D)重陽節

下列何者與夫妻相處之道無關？
        (A)相敬如賓   (B)倒屣相迎                               (C)舉案齊眉                 (D)鴻案相莊

劉勰《文心雕龍．知音》：「凡操千曲而後曉聲，觀千劍而後識器。」此段文句之意旨，用
        於求學時應秉持之態度，與下列何者最為相近？
        (A)戒慎恐懼，表裡如一       (B)逆水行舟，不進則退
        (C)讀萬卷書，行萬里路       (D)博覽群觀，多方學習

有關辦理各類競賽所使用的題辭，下列何者有誤？
        (A)音樂：玉潤珠圓 (B)演講：餘音繞樑 (C)作文：洛陽紙貴                                        (D)書法：力透紙背

李斯《諫逐客書》：「向使四君卻客而不內，疏士而不與，是使國無富利之實，而秦無彊大
        之名也。」此係李斯以4位君王之例說明國之強盛，主要是因君王採取下列何種作為？
        (A)廣納賢才，有容乃大        (B)開疆拓土，統一天下
        (C)變法革新，自強不息        (D)虛心納諫，反求諸己

下列對聯所適用的場合，何者配對有誤？
        (A)扁鵲重生稱妙手／華佗再世頌丹心—醫院 (B)相留燕趙齊梁客／借寓東西南北人—旅館
        (C)劉伶問道誰家好／李白回言此處佳—茶館 (D)還我廬山真面目／愛他秋水舊風采—相館


    貳、英文：100 %
     【單選題：40 題，每題 2.5 分，共 100 分；請在『答案卡』題號 16~55 畫記作答。】

We all agree that the manager’s idea, although promising, still needs ________ out before it can be
        fully implemented.
        (A) try                (B) to try             (C) being tried          (D) trying

I didn’t use to like ice cream very much, but now I can’t ________ having it on hot summer days.
        (A) reduce                 (B) refuse           (C) reject             (D) resist

Which is a good response to “Ready to order”?
        (A) In a couple of minutes.                   (B) No, thanks.
        (C) Do I have to?                             (D) I’m not hungry yet.

I had high hopes for the soup at that new restaurant, but I ended up disappointed — it tasted ________,
        which ruined the delicate balance I was expecting.
        (A) sweetly              (B) to be hot           (C) of garlic            (D) with fish

We got stuck in traffic for such a long time ________ we missed our appointment with the clients.
        (A) that                 (B) and                 (C) because          (D) before

Willy got a 3,000-dollar ________ for his full attendance last year.
        (A) bonus               (B) price               (C) fund                (D) merit
                                   共同科目(國文、英文)               第 2 頁，共 4 頁

Peter has such an extensive vocabulary that he is, ________, a walking dictionary.
        (A) to say so           (B) so to speak         (C) so to tell         (D) so to put

There’s a police car parked outside our neighbor’s house, and it’s been there for a while. What do you
        suppose ________?
        (A) happened            (B) did happen         (C) has happened          (D) would happen

You need to ________ a proposal to apply for approval for your project.
        (A) present           (B) issue               (C) describe            (D) offer

“I was overwhelmed by the heavy workload, weren’t you?” Choose the best response.
        (A) Yes, it’s overstaffed.                  (B) No, you should take a break.
        (C) Yes, they need to hire more people.     (D) No, I don’t know where to download it.

Going to a gym to work out has become a ________ in Taiwan.
        (A) exercise          (B) trend             (C) style                     (D) popular

Tom turns 65 next year so he will ________.
        (A) resign             (B) be fired              (C) retire               (D) return home

Anna and Cathy haven’t seen each other ________ high school graduation.
        (A) in               (B) since              (C) before              (D) at

Many citizens looked upon the worsening economic situation ________, demanding urgent government
        intervention.
        (A) as critical        (B) to be critical    (C) being critical      (D) critical

The sky is getting dark. I think it’s ________ rain.
        (A) about to             (B) will to             (C) like to              (D) meaning to

Gardening is the biggest single hobby in America — the one ________ Americans spend the most
        time, energy, and money.
        (A) that               (B) which             (C) on that         (D) on which

Evan has a bad temper and no one wants to be ________ him.
        (A) nearly             (B) away from          (C) about                   (D) around

You were opposed to ________ to join us for dinner last night, weren't you?
        (A) our inviting her  (B) us invite her       (C) that we invite her (D) we inviting her

The show must win the approval of the critics and audience in New York, ________ it is being
        performed at the Palace Theater.
        (A) that                (B) which           (C) when             (D) where

TSMC pays well, but many people quit ________ the long work hours.
        (A) because          (B) avoid             (C) since               (D) because of

You ________ right now. The train is leaving in an hour.
        (A) would rather go  (B) had better go         (C) had rather gone        (D) would better go

UberEats is a food delivery ________ used by lots of people.
        (A) network             (B) platform          (C) website                 (D) station

Given the possibility of aftershocks, it’s clearly wiser to think ahead now than to later regret ________
        any preparations.
        (A) making               (B) having made           (C) not having made (D) have not made

The HR manager from our Boston branch has just arrived though I didn’t know he ________ until
        yesterday.
        (A) comes           (B) will come         (C) was coming          (D) had been coming

A positive company culture often rewards strong performance. For example, there is a(n) ________
        scheme in place to recognize and motivate highly efficient employees.
        (A) encouragement      (B) incentive          (C) initiative          (D) compensation
                                  共同科目(國文、英文) 第 3 頁，共 4 頁                                【請翻頁繼續作答】

When science was still ________, the Greeks believed that the Earth was at the center of the universe.
        (A) in its beginning   (B) in its origin      (C) in its infancy      (D) in its phase

I should have studied architecture. I ________ really good at it.
        (A) must have been      (B) should have been (C) couldn’t have been (D) would have been

Don’t make reservations at the Spring Restaurant ________ you’re prepared to spend a lot of money.
        (A) until             (B) unless              (C) since              (D) although

Every new employee ________ take special training courses.
        (A) is needed to     (B) must to             (C) is required to          (D) is order to

________ the movie was so boring, I doubt I would have gone to see it.
        (A) I had known if   (B) If I knew           (C) If had I known        (D) Had I known

To apply for a job, ________ the application form first.
        (A) read out            (B) write in            (C) print in             (D) fill out

The new administration ________ the quality of preschool education nationwide.
        (A) is committed to improve                  (B) is committed to improving
        (C) has committed to improve                 (D) has committed to be improved

Debbie and I ________. We’ve been friends since high school and still see each other every few weeks
        even after all these years.
        (A) are back on our way                       (B) know our way
        (C) never lose our way                        (D) go way back

She quickly reached a level of musicianship that the rest of us can only ________.
        (A) aspire to           (B) admire to          (C) allude to             (D) attain to

The high cost of living in big cities is steadily ________ people’s savings. As a result, many decide to
        relocate to suburban areas.
        (A) eating into          (B) cutting up            (C) draining away     (D) weighing on

Despite coming from very different backgrounds, Sarah and Jack always seem to ________ on
        important issues.
        (A) catch their eyes (B) keep an eye out   (C) see eye to eye   (D) feast their eyes

I got my fridge ______ last week and now it’s running smoothly.
        (A) repair             (B) repaired            (C) fix up                (D) better

We should be ________ and recycle.
        (A) environmental protection                     (B) eco-friendly
        (C) conscious                                    (D) love Earth

I really put my ________ in it when I met our German business partner. Because I was so nervous, I
        accidentally said “Who are you?” instead of “How are you?”.
        (A) tongue             (B) finger             (C) hand              (D) foot

The marketing team proposed a digital campaign to target younger consumers, ________ the sales
        department favored a more traditional approach using print media.
        (A) however           (B) despite             (C) whereas          (D) unless




                                   共同科目(國文、英文)               第 4 頁，共 4 頁
